rootCauseHypothesis:
The click action likely timed out because the 'Next motorcycle' control did not respond promptly on the host page. This is commonly caused by a blocked/covered button, a JavaScript exception or infinite/redundant re-render in the carousel handler, or very heavy client-side work triggered by the click that keeps the page busy long enough for the automation watchdog to time out. recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Inspect the 'Next motorcycle' button and surrounding hero carousel for any click-blocking overlays, duplicated elements, or heavy carousel logic that hangs the main thread. On the hosting side, optimize or defer expensive work triggered by the click (animations, image loading, state updates, analytics), ensure the button is truly interactive and not covered by another layer, and verify the carousel uses a fast, synchronous event handler that completes within the 15s watchdog. If the carousel is initialized lazily, make sure it is fully ready before the test clicks it, and consider reducing re-render depth or animation duration so the click response is immediate.
